page.title: SaaS Portfolio Monitoring: Health & Costs | SaaS Sentinel

findings.title: Eyebrow label above the hero headline
findings.evidence: “SaaS Portfolio Intelligence (SPI)” (12px, tracked caps) sits directly above a 60px h1. The tiny label + giant headline pairing is the default generated SaaS hero.
findings.fix: Fold the label into the headline or the first sentence. If it's an announcement, make it a real link somewhere else.

findings.title: 11 untouched shadcn/ui cards
findings.evidence: Class strings like “rounded-lg border border-border bg-card p-6” are the component library's defaults, unmodified. Fine as scaffolding; as the final look it's tell #1.
findings.fix: Change the tokens (radius, border colour, shadow) once in your theme so the components stop looking like the docs page.

findings.title: Centered hero: big headline, centered sub, centered buttons
findings.evidence: h1 at 60px, centered, with 2 centered blocks under it. On 23.5% of Show HN launches. It's the layout every builder emits when nobody chooses one.
findings.fix: Not a problem on its own, but combined with other tells it's the skeleton. Left-align and put the product next to the headline, or lead with the product itself.

findings.title: 5 tracked all-caps section labels
findings.evidence: Small uppercase, letter-spaced labels like “SaaS Portfolio Intelligence (SPI)” above sections. On 10.5% of Show HN launches, and usually redundant with the heading under them.
findings.fix: Delete the label or fold its word into the heading.

findings.title: 3 tap targets under 32px on a phone (6 with repeats)
findings.evidence: e.g. a.inline-flex.items-center “What is SaaS Portfolio Intelligence?” 246×20px; a.mt-3.inline-flex “Learn more” 91×20px; a.mt-5.inline-flex “More about Supabase monitoring” 232×20px. Apple's floor is 44pt, WCAG's 24px with space around it.
findings.fix: Give links and buttons padding so the hit area is at least 44×44px on touch screens, or at least 24px with space around it.
findings.citation: WCAG 2.5.8 target size (24px, with spacing and inline exceptions); Apple HIG 44pt
